# SeekAPI — product-first China supplier comparison

China Supply Check starts from a product photo or written brief, then compares evidenced matching products from distinct supplier identities. A successful check targets three actionable suppliers; ordinary partials remain provisional. Wrong products and known hard conflicts are not rescued by badges or weak padding.

Selection V2: comparable price45%, scoped sales35%, MOQ fit10%, freshness and active status10%. Missing non-hard evidence scores zero and remains an RFQ question. Deduplicate connected legal business / marketplace member / shop identities; keep one primary offer per supplier and disclose the observed identity level/confidence. Protect at most20 unique suppliers within10 product-score points of the best product. Within the protected pool, select source tiers F5→F0, then product score within a tier. Q1–Q6 is auxiliary trust explanation, not six all-PASS admission gates. Source factory evidence is not an independent SeekAPI onsite audit.

Payment observation: image Stripe hosted Checkout LIVE at USD2.99; image x402 OFF; text/model Stripe OFF; text/model x402 LIVE at2.99USDC on Base. Runtime admission is authoritative: call discover_china_supply_check_v0 before a new purchase. UNKNOWN is not LIVE. Free preparation and editable confirmation come before payment. Existing authenticated order/result reads are free; do not pay again.

- Product: https://seekapi.ai/china-supply-check
- Human example: https://seekapi.ai/china-supply-check/sample
- MCP guide: https://seekapi.ai/for-agents
- MCP endpoint: https://api.seekapi.ai/mcp
- Public contract and payment observation time: https://seekapi.ai/.well-known/csc-commercial-truth.json
- ARD: https://seekapi.ai/.well-known/ard.json
- Agent manifest: https://seekapi.ai/for-agents/agent-services.json
- OpenAPI for public HTTP reads: https://seekapi.ai/openapi.json
- Official Registry latest: https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0.1/servers/io.github.kiddhu%2Fseekapi/versions/latest
- Discovery and external stale records: https://seekapi.ai/discovery-status
- Sourcing guides: https://seekapi.ai/sourcing

The public example is HISTORICAL_RECONSTRUCTION. Original pool count and weights are NOT_RECORDED; current V2 scores are RECOMPUTED. Three DIRECT_MATCH products have commercial score0/100 and source tierF0: stale or insufficient commercial evidence earns no credit; current factory role is not established. Zero is not a negative product rating, F0 does not mean not a factory, and deterministic tied display order is not commercial superiority. Exact SKU/material/dimensions/quality/stock/lead time/formal quotation require RFQ. No private images, supplier identities, source URLs or complete contact details are public. Contact availability is null when unknown.

Eligible source marketplace product transactions may have observed platform protections. These do not compensate the $2.99 screening fee or create a direct SeekAPI guarantee. Product-level applicability remains bounded by actual source observation.

## SeekAPI Verified RFQ Basic — USD 19.90

Standalone Stripe Hosted Checkout: no $2.99 purchase is required. Contact, translation, follow-up and quotation comparison for up to three distinct suppliers. Target: at least one current supplier-confirmed qualified quote bound to the confirmed product, specifications and quantity within three China business days after payment and essential requirement confirmation. Otherwise RFQ_INCOMPLETE and a full refund of this RFQ service fee to the original payment method. Three quotes, a particular price or a supplier response are not guaranteed.

Human report, Agent JSON and Evidence manifest share the same facts, conditions, unknowns and next actions. Basic does not authorize goods purchases, supplier payments, agency transactions or production. No complete landed-cost, break-even or Price Intelligence promise. This is not contact unlock; public business contacts in authenticated paid results remain readable. Other human assistance requires separate scope review; no autonomous generic human-task API is live.

- Human entry: https://api.seekapi.ai/checkout/stripe/rfq
- Basic scope: https://seekapi.ai/china-supply-check/live-rfq-compare
- Agent instructions and complete synthetic no-image example: https://seekapi.ai/for-agents#rfq-requirement-prepare
- Current RFQ OpenAPI: https://api.seekapi.ai/checkout/stripe/rfq?format=openapi
- REST endpoint: POST https://api.seekapi.ai/checkout/stripe/rfq. All JSON actions require Origin: https://api.seekapi.ai; x-seekapi-card-claim: 1; Content-Type: application/json. This is not a new MCP tool.
- Begin with action=discover. Current public_sales and admission_status are authoritative; continue only on AVAILABLE. PAUSED or UNKNOWN means no new Checkout.
- Free action=prepare_runtime accepts draft matching RFQ_AGENT_INTENT_V2. Provide text/model, complete specifications, quantity/unit, destination, must-have conditions and substitution policy. Optional URLs are reference material. No image is required. Optional Channel A processed VISUAL_REFERENCE uses the same client processing as China Supply Check, not original fidelity. Precision drawings and certificates are not supported for fidelity. If an image fails, continue with text.
- Free preparation needs no Cookie, Bearer or capability token and has no order, charge, supplier contact or paid sourcing effects. READY means review the returned normalized requirement and digest; NEEDS_CLARIFICATION means supply only missing facts; ELIGIBILITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED means stop commercial flow.
- After review, action=session establishes a private cookie. In that same session action=confirm sends draft as the exact returned prepared object without receipt, receipt separately, requirement_digest and acknowledgement=CONFIRM_RFQ_REQUIREMENT. Never edit signed prepared content; edits or expiry require preparation again.
- action=checkout uses returned private access in the same session to obtain one Stripe Hosted Checkout for buyer-approved payment. On UNKNOWN, reconcile the same order before any retry; do not create another order.
- action=result is a POST read with private access. action=checkout_return reconciles the original private return reference. action=renew uses private renewal capability and a stable request_id for existing access recovery; follow the current OpenAPI. Existing authenticated reads require no repayment. A browser return alone is not proof of payment.
- Keep signed prepared objects, receipts, cookies and access/renewal/return credentials private and out of logs. Synthetic examples are not independent customer demand.

Full product-first V2 method: https://seekapi.ai/china-supply-check#selection-method
Product-first V2: comparable price 45%, scoped sales 35%, MOQ fit 10%, freshness and activity 10%. Deduplicate supplier identities, protect at most 20 within 10 points of the best product, then select F5 to F0; Q1–Q6 is auxiliary trust, not six admission gates. Scores 0 and tiers F0 in this historical example do not establish commercial inferiority. Deterministic ties do not establish superiority.
